title: TRIPWIRE MINES IN CO-OP
why: His feature 6 of 2026-10-12, the tripwire mine, in two-player play. The wire is now shared. A wire player 2 strings is strung for real in the host window, which runs the machines and the pillagers, under his seat, so what it kills is his kill. Both windows see every wire, and when a wire goes off, runs out, or is the oldest of four, the host tells the other window, which takes its copy down and shows the blast. A wire still never hurts a player.
now: In co-op, a Tripwire Mine from either player is shared, and its kills go to whoever strung it.
